QuestInfo.name: Conquerors of the Mine
QuestInfo.0: Albert looks depressed after all he has been through recently. He says he has something to do for Edelstein as the manager.
QuestInfo.1: Animals that live in the mountains near the mine have taken over the mine. They are using the tools left by the miners as weapons and acting like the mines are their home. Go take the tools away from them so that they are no longer a threat.
QuestInfo.2: You have taken the tools from the animals protesting in the Rue Mines.

0.0: I feel awful. I was too preoccupied about Gabrielle that I didn't pay enough attention to my job. It's only right that everyone wants me to step down. I should've taken better care of the mines!
0.1: Animals have stolen all the leftover mining equipment and are using them as weapons. We have to deal with them. Will you help me perform this one last act as council president?

yes.0: Go to #b#MDmirrorD_325_2_##k and take away the tools the animals are wielding as weapons. If you can collect #r10#k #r#t4009040##k, #r#t4009042##k, and #r#t4009044##k items, I'm sure the animals will back off.

no.0: You have no faith in me either, huh? I don't blame you...

1.0: Did you get the tools? Good! Then the animals are no longer a threat!
